Legend keys for interval glyph types

Source: R/seq_interval_glyph.R
seq_glyph_legend_keys.Rd

Builds one LegendKey per glyph type, each drawing a miniature of the glyph through the key's draw function. Use it to label seq_interval_glyph() or seq_cross_arch() glyphs in a legend.

Usage

seq_glyph_legend_keys(
  glyphs = character(),
  labels = NULL,
  all = FALSE,
  color = "grey30"
)

Arguments

glyphs

Character vector of glyph types ("point", "latest", "earliest", "interval", "untimed"); others, including "hidden", are ignored. Keys follow that fixed order.

labels

Optional named character overriding the default labels (point = "point estimate", latest = "upper bound", earliest = "lower bound", interval = "interval", untimed = "no estimate").

all

Logical. Return keys for all five types regardless of glyphs.

color

Glyph colour in the keys.

Value

A named list of LegendKey objects (names are glyph types).

Examples

keys <- seq_glyph_legend_keys(c("point", "latest"))
names(keys)
#> [1] "point"  "latest"
